reasons.plausibility: The concept of a self-healing passive film is supported by known passivation mechanisms in multi-principal element systems, although detailed kinetics at grain boundaries under dual wear-corrosion conditions remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: The proposed side-by-side experiment with carefully controlled wear and corrosion environments allows direct measurement and comparison of film regeneration and degradation rates, providing a clear test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses an important challenge in high-entropy alloys for harsh environments and offers a specific mechanism to investigate, making it highly relevant and valuable to researchers.
